profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Dayforce
profile.summary:
Proficient in C# development with a speciality in .NET Core web applications utilizing Angular, React, and Blazor frontends, Xamarin cross platform mobile development, and WPF desktop development.

I’m also a huge believer in the cloud, and have experience building, deploying, and hosting web applications in Azure and AWS. I’ve leveraged tools like Git, CircleCI, Github Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, and more to help build automated and reliable deployments. I would describe my skill set as a strategic mix of software and infrastructure knowledge that makes me useful in any part of the tech stack.

positions.title: Mobile Sales Consultant
positions.description:
As a trusted advisor and partner, develops strong relationships with customers and bring them a little closer to family and friends by helping them close the gaps with technology.

Engages customers utilizing selling skills to build connected solutions while maintaining a balance of high velocity and high service. Sells a broad range of mobile products and services using a proven structured approach while at the same time developing in-depth knowledge of the latest mobile technology.

positions.title: Assistant Superintendent
positions.description:
Assisted the superintendent with day to day management and upkeep while supervising a small team of crew members. Responsibilities included:

*Assigning tasks and following up to make sure they were completed correctly
*Working both individually and in a team to complete daily tasks
*Finding creative and efficient solutions to complex problems

volunteerExperiences.description: Participated in a committee that puts on events that raise up to $3000 anually for a range of philanthropies such as the Red Cross, Alzheimer's Association, and St. Jude's Children's Hospital.
